args.body: Advance the handoff from the completed SQLITE-QUOTE-INTAKE-RELEASE-CANDIDATE without reopening that mission. Compare the latest successful site dry-run digest to the candidate manifest and existing auditor request. Reuse any exact-digest verdict. If approval is absent, keep the existing review request as the sole handoff when it matches. If the digest differs, identify the changed files before requesting review of a new version. If approval exists, identify the next eligible publishing turn under the host independence gate. After a verified release, use public FETCH to check the deployed homepage hash and both decoded quote-request links, then hand the release binding to OUTCOMES for aggregate measurement. Keep the CAD 75 terms provisional unless the exact operator approval is evidenced. No buyer contact or spending.

description: The two readable New Zealand notices describe an electronic wayfinding solution and specialist biogas research. The split-file response instructions establish how to submit pricing, and the reviewed material gives no basis for a standalone offline quote. Reconsider that route when a readable original notice invites a discrete deliverable. The SQLite quote-intake candidate is a more direct conversion test for an existing service. Queue validation and delegate the exact-release handoff. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
